ai.instructions: This extension reads the currently logged-in student's AzTU (Azerbaijan Technical University) LMS account. Every tool is read-only and always acts on that student. Discover ids by chaining tools: get a lecture's `id` from `get-lectures` before calling any lecture-specific tool (materials, syllabus, attendance); get a semester's `sem_code` from `get-transcript` before calling `get-semester-scores`; get an announcement or material `id` from its list tool before reading its content. Subject, teacher, and weekday names are often in Azerbaijani. Attendance scores are out of 10. In `get-schedule`, the week type is `Daimi` (every week), `Üst həftə` (upper week), or `Alt həftə` (lower week); combine it with today's date to answer questions about 'today' or 'this week'.
